steps.content: After shattering the last relief, EMP leans against the wall, out of breath.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Phew... Phew... Give me a second...
Hella is also a little shaken, but when she sees EMP panting heavily against the wall, she pulls herself together.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's wrong with you? Too afraid to move? It's a disgrace for Syndicate to have a wimp like you.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: But those stone shadows were terrifying! And there were so many of them! They came out of nowhere and jumped on all together!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Scared the hell out of me... M-my legs are still shaking...
EMP's chest rises and falls violently, and her pale cheeks are covered with sweat. Hella looks at the other frightened girl, and without realizing it, her tone softens.
She hesitates for a moment and pats EMP's shoulder somewhat awkwardly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...All right, okay. I won't make fun of you anymore.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But we have to pick up the pace, ${PlayerName} is still waiting for us. After we find him, we can work together to discover the truth about these mutations and catch the person behind them!
